correctness.rationale: Round-r colours retain directed in/out neighbour multiplicities, hence all descending and ascending walk counts through depth r. Their exponential generating functions are products of truncated exponentials E_{x_i} and E_{m−x_i}. Taking formal logs modulo z^{r+1} recovers N_0,...,N_{r−1} and N_m,...,N_{m−r+1} by successive first-difference coefficients, with a possible central remaining value by subtracting from d. At r=ceil(m/2) the multiset is determined, and coordinate permutations preserve every directed edge. One-dimensional directed chain has two interior vertices indistinguishable before ceil(m/2), so uniform optimality holds. Independent explicit refinement verified 18 m,d profiles; finite checks not proof.
